item.title: Supreme Court Links Menstrual Health to Right to Life, Orders Free Sanitary Napkins in Schools
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Supreme Court on Friday , January 30, declared that the right to menstrual health forms an integral part of the right to life under Article 21 of the Constitution. In a significant move aimed at safeguarding the dignity and health of adolescent girls, the Court issued a series of directions to ensure better menstrual hygiene facilities in schools across the country.
